name: Hu Delin
profile: Hu Delin (胡德霖, Hurun lists as 胡德林) was founder, chairman and co-controlling shareholder of Suzhou Electrical Apparatus Science Academy (EETI, SZSE 300215), a high/low-voltage electrical equipment testing firm. He died on 3 May 2023 aged 72; the company announced it on 26 June 2023.
interesting_fact: He led the 1999 restructuring of the state-run Suzhou Electrical Apparatus Research Institute into a private company and took it public on ChiNext in May 2011.
notes: Deceased (May 2023, source: Sina Finance 2023-06-26). Son Hu Chun (胡醇, Hurun co-listee) is now controlling shareholder of EETI (300215.SZ).

name: Charles Odell Schiff
current_role: Director, Cincinnati Financial Corp (CINF); EVP, secretary & treasurer, John J. & Thomas R. Schiff & Co. Inc.
profile: Charles O. 'Charlie' Schiff is a nonindependent director of Cincinnati Financial (since Aug 2020, investment committee) and an executive of John J. & Thomas R. Schiff & Co., the privately owned Cincinnati independent insurance agency bearing the names of CINF's founding-era Schiff family. His wealth reflects a large CINF stake (~1.1M+ shares).
interesting_fact: He joined the CINF board in 2020 as Thomas R. Schiff stepped down under the director age guideline; the company said he would give insight into how CINF serves its primary customer, the independent agent.
deep_cut_fact: A Fordham history graduate (magna cum laude), he has served on the boards of The Children's Theater of Cincinnati and The Cincinnati Observatory, among other local nonprofits.
notes: Low public profile; contacts are Cincinnati Financial corporate (2020 release, may have changed). Insurance industry, not energy-related.

name: Peter Dawson
profile: Most likely Peter Michael Dawson (1938-2024), executive chairman and owner of Dawsongroup, the UK truck/trailer/equipment rental group grown from his father Ted's one-lorry Leighton Buzzard haulage firm (1935). He launched Dawsonrentals in 1974. He died in 2024 after a short illness.
interesting_fact: In 1994 Commercial Motor reported he topped the Sunday Times list of richest truck-industry figures, owning 75% of Dawsongroup, then valued at £100m.
notes: Deceased (2024), source: https://dawsongroup.co.uk/peter-michael-dawson-1938-2024/ . Identity inferred from 'Transport' + UK Rich List; Dawsongroup is the only UK transport Peter Dawson with Rich List coverage found.

name: Liao Dinghai
current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Guangzhou Hi-Target Navigation Tech Co. (SZSE 300177)
profile: Liao Dinghai (b. 1963), a naval hydrographic surveyor turned entrepreneur, founded Hi-Target (中海达), a Guangzhou maker of GNSS/BeiDou surveying, mapping and marine-survey equipment that listed on ChiNext in 2011. He has chaired it since 2009 and was re-elected for a three-year term in May 2024; son Liao Wen is a director and VP.
interesting_fact: He graduated from the Dalian Naval Academy's marine surveying department and spent nearly 20 years in the PLA Navy as a unit leader and senior engineer doing marine surveying before running Hi-Target.
deep_cut_fact: Since 2015 he and Hi-Target's executives have funded a RMB10m 'Hi-Target Love Fund' (中海达爱心基金) that supports employees and their families facing serious illness or accidents.
notes: Hurun co-listee Liao Wen is his son. Relevant to podcast via BeiDou/GNSS positioning tech. Contact via board secretary office.

name: Dou Qiling
current_role: Chairwoman and controlling shareholder, Guizhou Yibai Pharmaceutical Co. (SSE 600594)
profile: Dou Qiling (窦啟玲, b. 1960), a co-founder of Guizhou Yibai Pharmaceutical in Guiyang, has led the company as chair, vice-chair and general manager over the years; it makes traditional-Chinese-medicine and oncology drugs (e.g. Aidi injection). Her daughter Dou Yaqi is now vice-chair and general manager.
interesting_fact: She holds a doctorate in business administration and is one of the few women founder-chairs of a listed Chinese drugmaker; the family runs Yibai as a two-generation team.
notes: Pharma, not energy. Company has had several regulatory warnings (2019, 2024) - avoid in outreach. Contact via board secretary email.
